answer: Arrival-curl matching.** Each node samples the inter-arrival gaps of a new identity's first 200 messages and compares the traffic-shape against a memorized plume of organic join patterns. An adversary must stretch registrations across weeks of jittered, human-paced traffic to fit; bursts matching a dune of near-identical gaps get throttled. Honest clients that fall outside the harbor of accepted shapes pay one extra challenge round, while farms pay per-identity delay plus compute for shape-mimicking.
